briefdescription.para: Rejects operands that cannot be compared with == or written.

detaileddescription.para: Selected for the operands that eq() does not accept (see detail::comparable_operands); it stops the compilation with a message that states what is wrong, instead of the notes of the concepts. Never called.

Type of the right hand side operand.
lhs
Left hand side operand.
rhs
Right hand side operand.
false, to avoid further errors in the check; the type is not deduced, so that the call can be used in an unevaluated operand.
Never called; the compilation stops in detail::reject_comparison(), with a message that names the mistake.

briefdescription.para: C++ header file with inline implementations for the µTest++ function comparators.

detaileddescription.para: This header provides the inline implementations for the function comparator templates used within the µTest++ framework. It defines the logic for generic comparison functions, including equality, non-equality, greater than, less than, greater than or equal, less than or equal, and the approximate comparison. Additionally, it implements logical combinators such as conjunction (all_of), disjunction (any_of), and negation (negate).

These comparators and logical operators enable expressive and type-safe test expectations and assertions; the C strings are compared by content, the other pointers by address. The logical combinators have descriptive names, since and, or, and not are alternative tokens and cannot be used as identifiers.
All definitions reside within the micro_os_plus::micro_test_plus namespace.
The header files are organised within the include/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus folder to maintain a structured and modular codebase.
This file is included by function-comparators.h; the applications include micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus.h, not this file.
